notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run and no hardware backend (the device is simulated R0). The card's entry symbol rover_envs.envs.navigation.entrypoints:RoverEnv was confirmed at rover_env.py:12; the served registration is AAURoverEnv-v0. The upstream Isaac Sim 6.0.1 / Isaac Lab environment was not run (not installed, GPU required), so the fake is an F0 analytic kinematic stand-in and was not compared with it. NOT COVERED: the height_scan observation array (GridPatternCfg resolution 0.05, size [5.0, 5.0] at rover_env_cfg.py:106-114); the fake carries the last action plus the three target terms (5 values) and omits the scan. Also not modelled: the eight reward terms, the timeout/success/far-from-target/collision terminations, the terrain and spawn sampling, the reset options, the wheel-level Ackermann mapping, and contact/friction/actuator/sensor dynamics. The clone states no numeric action bounds (the Isaac Lab base outside the repository owns the space), so the fake publishes an unbounded two-element Box; no bound was invented and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is the consequence. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the pending seed without a native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for action_space, observation_space, reset and close, which are Gymnasium interface members inherited from ManagerBasedRLEnv outside the clone; G8.NO_UNIT x4 for bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.values, seed twice). RoverEnv's docstring calls it a placeholder (rover_env.py:13-16) although it is the registered entry point and delegates step to ManagerBasedRLEnv. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
